s1.syndrome_frame: Painless orbital mass with proptosis and facial numbness, with a history of treated Hodgkin lymphoma
key_facts: 34-year-old African American woman
History of nodular sclerosing type stage IIE Hodgkin lymphoma
Treated with 4 cycles of ABVC and 3060 cGY radiation
Painless left upper eyelid mass excised three times
Proptosis developed four months later
Left-sided facial numbness developed seventeen months later
Histopathology showed multinodular proliferation of osteoclast-like multinucleated giant cells
Immunohistochemistry positive for CD68 and negative for CD45, S100, desmin, and lysozyme
MRI showed lesion with marked interval enlargement within the orbit and extension into the intracranial compartment

shortlist.label: Giant cell tumor of soft tissue (GCT-ST)
shortlist.why_kept: Histopathology showed multinodular proliferation of osteoclast-like multinucleated giant cells, and immunohistochemistry was positive for CD68, consistent with GCT-ST

shortlist.label: Tenosynovial giant cell tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Similar histopathological features to GCT-ST, and possible involvement of the orbit and surrounding tissues

shortlist.label: Histiocytic sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Given the patient's history of Hodgkin lymphoma and the presence of a painless orbital mass with proptosis and facial numbness

shortlist.label: Rosai-Dorfman disease
shortlist.why_kept: Characterized by the presence of multinodular proliferation of histiocytes, which could be consistent with the patient's histopathology findings

shortlist.label: Langerhans cell histiocytosis
shortlist.why_kept: Possible involvement of the orbit and surrounding tissues, and the presence of multinodular proliferation of histiocytes

s4.champion: Giant cell tumor of soft tissue (GCT-ST)

raw.champion: Giant cell tumor of soft tissue (GCT-ST)
raw.rationale: The histopathology showing a multinodular proliferation of osteoclast-like multinucleated giant cells and the immunohistochemistry positive for CD68 are consistent with GCT-ST. The clinical presentation of a painless mass and subsequent proptosis and facial numbness also align with the behavior of GCT-ST, which can be locally aggressive.

rejected.label: Tenosynovial giant cell tumor
rejected.why: Typically involves the joints or tendons, which is not mentioned in the case

rejected.label: Histiocytic sarcoma
rejected.why: Would likely have a more aggressive clinical course and different immunohistochemical profile

rejected.label: Rosai-Dorfman disease
rejected.why: Usually presents with lymphadenopathy and has a distinct immunohistochemical profile, including positivity for S100

rejected.label: Langerhans cell histiocytosis
rejected.why: Typically has a different clinical presentation, including bone lesions and pulmonary involvement, and is positive for CD1a and S100
